name: Theorems, definitions & proofs
description: Numbered theorem, lemma and definition environments sharing one counter, plus `proof` with a QED box.
notes: `[theorem]` in `\newtheorem{lemma}[theorem]{Lemma}` makes lemmas share the theorem counter (Theorem 1.1, Lemma 1.2, …).
`[section]` on the first one resets numbering every section. Drop it for 1, 2, 3, ….
The three styles: `plain` (italic body, for results), `definition` (upright), `remark` (lighter heading).
